text: {"lessons":["I will not sell just because a holding is below my purchase price; I will reassess its prospects and my plan before acting.","My buys and sells have often lacked a consistent strategy, including selling B and E at losses and repeatedly adding to individual stocks. I will set clear reasons and position limits before trading.","I will monitor cash, diversification, and total portfolio risk—not just account value—and keep decisions aligned with my long-term apartment goal."]}
